regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in semiconductors, federal IT/defense, and AI infrastructure, but several signals mix fundamental activity with sentiment or affiliations rather than independently confirmed buying. With no scored track record yet, conviction remains modest; extended PLTR and CRWD should not be chased.
regime_read_zh: 当前信号主要汇聚于半导体、联邦政府IT/国防及AI基础设施，但不少组合将基本面活动与情绪或关联关系混在一起，并非均为独立确认的买入信号。由于尚无已评分战绩，整体置信度应保持克制；已明显延伸的PLTR和CRWD不宜追涨。

theses.thesis: MU has the cleanest policy-and-operating convergence: accelerating federal grants, a large patent cluster, strongly positive insider-purchase signal, and the proposed Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act all point toward sustained strategic attention to domestic advanced memory [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [bill:HR10170]. Bullish retail sentiment is supportive but is the least durable component [stocktwits_bull].
theses.thesis_zh: MU呈现出最清晰的政策与经营信号汇聚：联邦补助加速、较大的专利集群、强劲的内部人买入信号，以及《2026年存储芯片竞争力评估法案》，共同指向美国先进存储产业持续获得战略关注 [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [bill:HR10170]。散户情绪偏多提供辅助，但属于最不持久的部分 [stocktwits_bull]。
second_order: AMAT — domestic memory-capacity investment would support semiconductor-equipment demand
U.S. semiconductor-equipment theme — greater domestic memory investment implies additional fabrication-tool spending
theses.dissent: The grant acceleration is only 1.6x, the legislation merely requires a study, and memory pricing remains cyclical, so policy attention may not translate into near-term earnings.

falsifier.text: Federal support stops accelerating and MU's insider-purchase signal reverses while advanced-memory investment plans weaken.

theses.thesis: BAH combines accelerating federal-contract activity with a positive Trump-linked signal and a special-situation marker, creating a more coherent government-services setup than sentiment-led clusters [gov_contract_accel] [trump] [special_situation]. The 4.15x contract acceleration is the central measured signal, while the upcoming earnings date offers a near-term checkpoint rather than proof of the thesis.
theses.thesis_zh: BAH同时出现联邦合同活动加速、正向特朗普关联信号和特殊情形标记，相比主要由情绪推动的组合，其政府服务逻辑更为连贯 [gov_contract_accel] [trump] [special_situation]。4.15倍合同加速是核心实测信号，而即将到来的财报只是近期检验节点，并非论点本身的证明。
second_order: PLTR — broader federal data-modernization spending could support adjacent analytics procurement
Federal cybersecurity and consulting theme — stronger agency procurement can flow through to implementation contractors
theses.dissent: Federal awards can be lumpy, and the special-situation and political signals may overlap with the same procurement narrative rather than represent fully independent demand.

falsifier.text: New federal awards normalize sharply and management does not convert the recent contract activity into improved backlog or outlook.

theses.thesis: IBM's extreme federal-contract acceleration aligns with a broad patent cluster and open-source development momentum, while its substantial relative underperformance leaves the setup unextended [gov_contract_accel] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]. The signal is potentially contrarian, but the unusually large acceleration figure may reflect a very small comparison base or one-off award, keeping conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: IBM的联邦合同极快加速与广泛专利集群、开源开发动能形成呼应，同时其显著相对落后意味着当前并未延伸 [gov_contract_accel] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]。这是一个潜在的逆向机会，但异常巨大的加速倍数可能源于极低基数或一次性合同，因此仅给予低置信度。
second_order: BAH — expanding federal technology programs can require consulting and implementation support
Federal AI and hybrid-cloud modernization theme — contract growth suggests continuing agency infrastructure demand
theses.dissent: The 3110.85x acceleration is vulnerable to a base effect, and patents plus GitHub activity do not by themselves establish commercial monetization.

falsifier.text: The contract surge proves to be a one-off award and subsequent federal bookings return to the prior run rate.

theses.thesis: PLTR has genuine multi-channel alignment through 3.2x government-contract acceleration, uniformly bullish analyst signals, disclosed ownership by Marjorie Taylor Greene, and Cathie Wood affiliation [gov_contract_accel] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]. However, retail and Stocktwits enthusiasm overlap, and the shares are already extended at +41.0 percentage points versus SPY over 60 days, so the evidence supports watching for a reset rather than chasing [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull].
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR确有多渠道汇聚：政府合同加速3.2倍、分析师信号一致偏多、Marjorie Taylor Greene披露持仓，以及Cathie Wood关联 [gov_contract_accel] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]。但散户热度与Stocktwits情绪存在重叠，而且过去60日相对SPY领先41.0个百分点，已属延伸，因此更适合等待回撤，而非追涨 [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]。
second_order: BAH — continued federal data-platform adoption can create integration and consulting work
Federal fraud-enforcement technology theme — H.R. 9576 could increase demand for cross-agency data sharing if it advances
theses.dissent: The strongest non-contract signals are crowded sentiment indicators, and the extended price already may discount continued federal growth.

falsifier.text: Government-contract acceleration falls back toward its prior pace while the stock remains priced at an extended relative-performance level.

theses.thesis: CRWD shows alignment across congressional buying, 13F additions, analyst upgrades, and a positive Trump-linked signal [congress_buy] [13f_add] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [trump]. Those channels are directionally supportive, but there is no contract or product-demand measurement in the cluster, and the stock is already extended at +36.5 percentage points versus SPY over 60 days; the entry is therefore gone for now.
theses.thesis_zh: CRWD在国会议员买入、13F增持、分析师上调以及正向特朗普关联信号之间形成一致方向 [congress_buy] [13f_add] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [trump]。这些渠道具有支持作用，但组合中缺少合同或产品需求的实测数据，而且过去60日相对SPY领先36.5个百分点，已明显延伸，因此当前买点已经错过。
second_order: Cybersecurity software theme — institutional and political buying suggests continued attention to security spending
MSFT — enterprise-security demand can also support integrated cloud-security platforms
theses.dissent: Institutional, congressional, and analyst signals may all be reacting to the same prior price strength rather than anticipating new fundamental acceleration.

falsifier.text: Congressional and institutional additions reverse without a corresponding improvement in measured customer or contract demand.
